# Checkbox

A single binary choice in a form. A binary that takes effect immediately is a `Toggle`; a set of exclusive choices is a `RadioGroup`.

## Anatomy

A native input, visually replaced by a square box carrying a check or a dash, and a label beside it.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `$bindable(false)` | — |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Neither checked nor unchecked — a parent whose children disagree. |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `labelHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the label visually while leaving it to assistive technology. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `describedby` | `string` | — | — |
| `id` | `string` | ``sanctum-checkbox-${crypto.randomUUID()}`` | — |
| `onchange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | — | — |

## Variants

None.

## States

Unchecked, checked, indeterminate, disabled, focus-visible.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves to and from the checkbox. |
| `Space` | Toggles it. |

## ARIA

A native `<input type="checkbox">` associated with its `<label>` by `for`/`id`, so role, checked state and name are native. `indeterminate` is set as the DOM property, which is the only way to express it. The drawn box is `aria-hidden`.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Reference correspondence

None. The reference has no checkbox at all; the box is drawn in its idiom — square corners, a hairline boundary at control contrast, the ink fill it uses for an active `Segmented` option.
